title: Next-session answer
description: The answer to the next-session request, next-session-request.schema.json: either the next session of the run, with next session, or the end of the run, with next end. The next session has session, workflow, time_limit_minutes, full_suite and inputs, and optionally model_choice and model_credential; the end has next only. An answer with the members of both shapes is refused. It answers a request that qory sends through Forager's link, which the gateway forwards to the control plane.

oneOf.description: The next session of the run: the session that qory starts.

next.description: The kind of the answer: session, a session follows.

session.description: The control plane's sequence number of this session in the run, from 1. It is not Forager's number of the session, which Forager assigns when qory joins the session.

workflow.description: The workflow that the session starts, as workflow of the run documents.

model_choice.description: The model choice of the session, as the model, effort, provider_models and tiers of run_settings. Absent when no provider is chosen: the session uses the gateway's configured key and the runtime's default model.

model_credential.description: The credential of the run that the session joins with, such as <the provider's public id>-<its place from 1>: example-provider-1. The schema checks only the pattern of a credential's name in Forager's policy. A credential of the start key's provider is the active key of that provider's group. Absent when no provider is chosen.

time_limit_minutes.description: The time limit of the session, in minutes, from 15 to 1440.

full_suite.description: Whether the session runs the full test suite after the agent ends.

inputs.description: The input of the session, as inputs of the run documents. qory writes it to the inputs file of the session.

oneOf.description: The end of the run: no session follows, and qory closes the run.

next.description: The kind of the answer: end, no session follows.
